- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.10) — reduce forecast by 2–5% for high sentiment.
- Underestimate prices after sharp spikes (e.g., >75% from prior 10-day high) — add 3–8% buffer to forecast.
- Overshoot in early 30-day horizon — cap forecast at 10% above 14-day moving average.
- Mean-reversion bias: if 18-day average is > 10% above forecast, reduce forecast by 5–10%.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment drops >0.30 over 3 days, reduce forecast by 3–7%.
- Avoid overconfidence in 30-day horizon — if sentiment is neutral or negative, reduce forecast by 1–3%.
- Correct for “sentiment echo” — if sentiment peaks 2–3 days before forecast, reduce forecast by 2–5% to avoid overreaction.
